question: The members of the Constituent Assembly signed the Constitution of India on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 24 January 1950.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **24 January 1950: **Last meeting of the Constituent Assembly. 'Constituent of India'(with 395 articles, 8 schedules, 22parts) was signed and accepted by all.
